description: This file implements an ICS Feed Calendar Service class for integrating and fetching calendar data from ICS feeds, with support for timezone handling, recurring events, and user timezone retrieval. It also provides methods for creating, updating, deleting events (read-only), and listing calendars.

classes.name: ICSFeedCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing calendar integration for ICS feeds, supporting fetching, timezone handling, and recurring event processing.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Stub method for creating an event, logs warning and returns a read-only response.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Stub method for deleting an event, logs warning.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Stub method for updating an event, logs warning and returns a read-only response.

methods.name: fetchCalendars
methods.description: Fetches and parses ICS calendar URLs into ICAL components.

methods.name: getUserTimezoneFromDB
methods.description: Retrieves user's timezone from the database using Prisma.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Extracts user ID from the first calendar in a list.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Calculates busy dates within a date range from fetched ICS calendars, handling recurring events and timezones.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists available calendars with their names and identifiers.
